abilities.effect: Halves damage taken from full HP.

kanto.flavorText: Only a very few people ever see this POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

original-johto.flavorText: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

hoenn.flavorText: It can circle the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

updated-johto.flavorText: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

original-unova.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

updated-unova.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

kalos.flavorText: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Dragonite is capable of circling the globe in just 16 hours. It is a kindhearted Pokémon that leads lost and foundering ships in a storm to the safety of land.

original-alola.flavorText: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it’s satisfied.

updated-alola.flavorText: You’ll often hear tales of this kindhearted Pokémon rescuing people or Pokémon that are drowning.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: It is said that this Pokémon lives somewhere in the sea and that it flies. However, these are only rumors.

swsh.flavorText: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.
